mapper.sql: c . id id, c . `comment_id` commentId, c.`comment_user_id` commentUserId, c.`comment_user_name` commentUserName, c.`comment_user_avatar` commentUserAvatar, c.`reply_user_id` replyUserId, c.`reply_user_name` replyUserName, c.`reply_user_avatar` replyUserAvatar, c.`activity_id` activityId, c.`parent_comment_id` parentCommentId, c.`content`, c.`user_id` userId, c.`ctime`, count(l.user_id) likeCount
mapper.select:
select
from corgi_activity_comment c left join corgi_comment_like l on l.comment_id = c.comment_id and l.status = '1' where c.activity_id = #{activityId} group by c.comment_id order by c.id desc

select
from corgi_activity_comment c left join corgi_comment_like l on l.comment_id = c.comment_id and l.status = '1' where c.activity_id = #{activityId} group by c.comment_id having likeCount > 0 order by likeCount desc limit 5

select
from corgi_activity_comment c left join corgi_comment_like l on l.comment_id = c.comment_id and l.status = '1' where c.parent_comment_id = #{commentId} group by c.comment_id order by id desc
select count(1) from corgi_activity_comment c left join corgi_activity_creator a on a.activity_id = c.activity_id where c.ctime like concat(#{date}, '%') and a.category = #{category}

select count(distinct c.comment_user_id) from corgi_activity_comment c left join corgi_activity_creator a on a.activity_id = c.activity_id where c.ctime like concat(#{date}, '%') and a.category = #{category}

select `comment_id` commentId, `comment_user_id` commentUserId, `comment_user_name` commentUserName, `comment_user_avatar` commentUserAvatar, `reply_user_id` replyUserId, `reply_user_name` replyUserName, `reply_user_avatar` replyUserAvatar, `activity_id` activityId, `parent_comment_id` parentCommentId, `content`, `ctime` from corgi_activity_comment where activity_id = #{activityId} and comment_user_id = #{userId} order by id desc limit 1
